headline: Al-Dibab market-transport hub double strike kills 80
dek: Wave of drone attacks across Sudan killed 160+ since Friday (medics, Emergency Lawyers). Deadliest: Al-Dibab, West Kordofan (RSF-controlled) — double drone strike 10 minutes apart on transport hub after market day; 80 killed, 47 wounded taken to Al-Mujlad where 30 later died (AFP medical source;…
sources: AFP (medical sources, witnesses); Reuters (JPost); Emergency Lawyers (rights group); UN Secretary-General spokesman Stephane Dujarric
fault_line: Who killed 80 commuters — the army or the RSF? And the drone-proliferation question: a civil war has become a drone-testing ground (880 civilian drone deaths Jan-Apr alone, 80% of all conflict deaths).

sections.what_happened: Wave of drone attacks across Sudan killed 160+ since Friday (medics, Emergency Lawyers). Deadliest: Al-Dibab, West Kordofan (RSF-controlled) — double drone strike 10 minutes apart on transport hub after market day; 80 killed, 47 wounded taken to Al-Mujlad where 30 later died (AFP medical source; witness Ahmed Wadi buried 50 bodies incl. his brother). Abyei disputed region: drones struck market, 73+ killed (Reuters via caretaker minister; JPost notes could not verify numbers). Blue Nile Friday: 41 displaced killed. Khartoum Monday: 3 children killed. Nyala Monday: 17 killed incl. 7 RSF officers. UN condemned the strikes Monday. Attribution contested: RSF's Tasis administration + Emergency Lawyers blame the army for Al-Dibab; RSF blamed for Blue Nile/Nyala.
sections.what_verified: Reuters, AFP, JPost, Al Jazeera, Guardian (witness), UN (Dujarric: 'alarmed by the continued deadly drone strikes across the country that are killing civilians, including children'), Emergency Lawyers, Mwenendo/TruExpress roundups, DW/RFI/France 24/AJA social coverage (AJA.Sudan post: 2.7K likes / 700 comments).
sections.what_disputed: Death tolls from single medical/witness sources, unverifiable in blackout zone; RSF and army each blame the other; conflicting Abyei numbers (53 per Sky News Arabia graphic vs 73+ per Reuters/minister); one viral threads post alleging UAE supplied RSF drones is UNVERIFIED.
sections.why_matters: The deadliest single strike of Sudan's war, 80 commuters waiting for rides home after market day — and two armies each pointing at the other. TOTW keeps the humanitarian frame: names, the double-tap 10 minutes apart, the UN condemnation, and the drone question neither side answers.
sections.context: Background: Sudan drone campaign: 160+ killed since Friday; Al-Dibab market-transport hub double strike kills 80; Abyei market strike kills 73+
